services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: An escape room is a physical adventure game in which players are locked in a room and have to use elements of the room to solve a series of puzzles and escape within a set time limit. You have 45 minutes to try and figure out the fiendish riddles and tricks to try to get out in

blurb: Dominion of Terror is a haunted house attraction that has been operating for 52 years, located in a property owned by RCS Empowers, Inc. for the last 19 years. The organization partners with RCS, a nonprofit supporting individuals with disabilities, and donates back to them annually. The haunted house is supported by various sponsors and volunteer partners from the local community.
